<pre>public final class <span class="typeNameLabel">MapFeatureModes</span>
extends java.lang.Object</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Holds constants for map feature modes, to be used with <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapscene#enableFeatures(java.util.Map)"><code>MapScene.enableFeatures(java.util.Map&lt;java.lang.String, java.lang.String&gt;)</code></a>.
 <p>See <a href="sdk-for-android-explore-api-reference-mapfeatures" title="class in com.here.sdk.mapview"><code>MapFeatures</code></a> for constants representing the feature names.</div>
</li>
</ul>

<h4>TRAFFIC_FLOW_JAPAN_WITHOUT_FREE_FLOW</h4>
<pre>public static final&nbsp;java.lang.String TRAFFIC_FLOW_JAPAN_WITHOUT_FREE_FLOW</pre>
<div class="block"><p>Only available when Japan map is used.
 <p>Traffic flow shows green lines depending on the region.
 <p>In Japan green lines will not be shown,
 as if the <a href="#TRAFFIC_FLOW_WITHOUT_FREE_FLOW"><code>TRAFFIC_FLOW_WITHOUT_FREE_FLOW</code></a> were used.
 <p>In rest of the world, green lines will be shown, as if
 the <a href="#TRAFFIC_FLOW_WITH_FREE_FLOW"><code>TRAFFIC_FLOW_WITH_FREE_FLOW</code></a> were used.</div>
<dl>
<dt><span class="seeLabel">See Also:</span></dt>
